Portrait Frame - Waist-Up.name: Portrait Frame - Waist-Up
Portrait Frame - Waist-Up.description:
🖼️ Portrait Framing: Waist-Up
Room for the face, torso and naturally visible hands without showing the lower outfit.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Portrait Frame - Waist-Up.traitNarrativeEffects: Vertical waist-up portrait from the top of the hair through the waist. Show the complete head, hair silhouette, face, neck, shoulders, torso, arms, hands when naturally visible, and upper outfit. Keep all visible anatomy inside the canvas with margin above the hair and around the elbows or hands. Do not show hips below the waist, thighs, knees, legs, or footwear. Do not tighten into face-only or chest-up framing or expand to three-quarter-body or full body.
